Corollary
[even-dimensional positive pinching without hypotheses]

Source: petersen:page-0451 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-sec-pinching-constant-curvature-closeness 1. ch11:11.4.18In even dimension $2n\ge 2$ and for $\lambda >0$, choose $\varepsilon =\varepsilon (n,\lambda )>0$ such that any closed Riemannian $2n$-manifold $(M,g)$ with $|\sec -\lambda |\le \varepsilon $ is $C^{1,\alpha }$ close to a metric of constant curvature $\lambda $ (in even dimensions, positive curvature alone bounds the diameter and, together with an upper curvature bound, the injectivity radius from below).
